roadmap.title: Prologue: Festival and Tar Golem
roadmap.description: Accept Marigold’s flower crown before taking your first Shell. Reduce the Tar Golem to zero health; quit to the menu during the fight to retry if needed. New Game+ skips these encounters.

roadmap.title: Explore the six Corrupted Gates
roadmap.description: Siphon seven Ova in Marrowkeep to unlock fast travel and corruption clearing. Explore the northern and southern regions for Shells and equipment. Get Peter’s Perfect Parry before defeating The Nameless Captive. Take Berserker’s Stone before the Heart of Vatra, and give Baghead no items.

roadmap.title: Prepare for the final area
roadmap.description: Upgrade a weapon to +16 and complete optional tasks such as Egon’s offering and Mango Sanctuary. Continue collecting equipment and clearing Beacons as you explore.

roadmap.title: Defeat the final bosses
roadmap.description: After at least five Corrupted Gate bosses, enter The Unfound Path from Marrowkeep’s Ova room. Defeat Orrem, The Monolith, Malborn Offspring, and Zmey. You can still explore after Zmey, so leave Send Ova until cleanup is finished.

roadmap.title: Finish Shells and memories
roadmap.description: Finish Beacons, Ova, Map Fragments, Tarstones, and equipment. Keep spare Fragile stones for the collection check and finish Gragu’s heart quest after securing Berserker’s Stone. Unlock every Shell and watch all five memories for each at Tier 4. Use Mether’s Severance to reuse Glimpses or farm Glimpse Stones in The Unfound Path.

roadmap.title: Send Ova and complete the list
roadmap.description: After all current-playthrough cleanup, choose Send Ova at Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon to trigger the ending. Earn every other achievement for No Lifer.

achievements.description: Claim your first Shell, Weapon and Sidearm
achievements.summary: Obtain your first Shell, melee weapon, and sidearm.

steps.text: Complete the opening equipment tutorial to receive your first Shell, melee weapon, and sidearm.

achievements.summary: Accept Marigold’s flower crown and enter the Festival.

steps.text: At the start of a new game, leave the courtyard and speak to @npc{Marigold}. Accept her flower crown before going to the first Shell.

achievements.summary: Arrive at Marrowkeep for the first time.

steps.text: Finish the prologue and enter @loc{Marrowkeep}.

achievements.summary: Watch a Shell Memory through the Shellkeeper’s bonding menu.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Zhirelle} at the Shellkeeper and select an unlocked Shell Memory in the bonding menu.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Axe and Dagger.

steps.text: South of @loc{Mushroom Village Beacon}, find the large pyre. Walk through the arch on the platform’s north edge while facing the fire. Take the @item{Chapel Key} from the rope on the revealed statue.
Use the key at @loc{Shrine of Trials}, northwest of Mushroom Village Beacon. In the first room, face the statue and walk backward through the wall.
Strike the puzzle blocks onto the floor switches in the remaining rooms. Take the @item{Axe and Dagger} at the end.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Great Martyr’s Blade.

steps.text: Find the castle northwest of @loc{Gloomshade Grove Beacon}. At its outer northeast corner, enter @loc{Martyr’s Prison} through the hole in the wall.
Use the bag on the stone counter. In the next area, defeat the four enemies in the locked room and take the blade from the room they guard.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Black Needle.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Sester’s Gate Beacon} and defeat the @enemy{Twin Sesters and Stray Sesters} at the end to receive the Black Needle.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Clockwork Scythe.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Sariel, the Endless} on the stone platform southeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}. Follow him through the wall he opens to the south into @loc{Chamber of Becoming}.
Pursue Sariel through the dungeon. In the last fight, destroy the four tombstones that let him revive, then finish the fight to receive the scythe.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Obsidian Hammer.

steps.text: From @loc{Outskirts of Mammon Beacon}, take the southwest paths and wooden bridges to @loc{Deserted Slums}. Drop into the central mining pit and enter @loc{Obsidianite Mines} on its southwest side.
Reach the dungeon’s end and defeat @enemy{Prophet of Profane Infinities} to receive the hammer.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Axatana.

steps.text: Northeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}, climb to the highest northeastern platform. Cross its Bone Gate to the tower near the eastern Corrupted Gate.
Press the button behind the tower to open the gate. Defeat the enemy inside and take the @item{Axatana}.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Veteran’s Battle Axe.

steps.text: Enter @loc{The King’s Crypt} through the cave northwest of Shattered Beacon. Follow the main route down the long drop, then take the axe from the body beside the enemy.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Caged Hystrix.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Sariel, the Endless} southeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}. Follow him through the opened southern wall into @loc{Chamber of Becoming}.
In the final fight, break the four tombstones that revive Sariel and defeat him. Climb the stairs at the back and take the @item{Caged Hystrix} near the exit.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Triarch Repeater.

steps.text: Descend behind @loc{Castigator’s Keep Beacon} and take the lower path north. Enter @loc{Blackwell Cavern} by the cliff, then collect the repeater from the ground in the first lit area.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Cursed Child.

steps.text: From @loc{Sester’s Gate Beacon}, climb the northwest stairs past the rolling enemy. Drop from the western platform to the Bone Gate ledge, then follow the path north past the hammer enemy to @loc{Revered Beacon}.
Inside, move counterclockwise toward the tower on the hill. Use walls for cover from the golden light, which damages you while it can see you.
Strike the tower’s central pillar to stop the light, then pick up the @item{Cursed Child}.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Ballistazooka.

steps.text: Climb the northwest stairs from @loc{Gate of Mammon Beacon}. Follow the building clockwise to the indoor stairs into @loc{Sentry’s Grave}.
Defeat @enemy{Subjugated Guardian} at the dungeon’s end to receive the Ballistazooka.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Salvaged Trebuchaxe.

steps.text: South of @loc{Gloomshade Grove Beacon}, defeat @enemy{Bloodcursed Lithopod} to open the route into @loc{Ravaged Hideout}. Take the Trebuchaxe from the body in the final room.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Forgotten Crossbow.

steps.text: Find the building northwest of @loc{Blackridge Pass Beacon}. Use its arch to reveal the doorway into @loc{Flooded Village}. Descend past the second elevator to the underground village.
Take the @item{Damp Key} from the box beside the house at the back left. Unlock the central building and take the crossbow from its table.

achievements.displayName: Bring My Ova Back to Me
achievements.summary: Gather every Ova awarded by the Beacons.

steps.text: Play the prologue and claim its Beacon rewards before leaving the opening area.
Clear every Beacon dungeon and take the Ova at the end. Defeat all six Corrupted Gate bosses and claim the Ova from their Beacons too.
If you have not unlocked day/night switching, take @item{Gloombound Flame} from a stone pillar behind Great Arbiter of Flesh, south of Widow’s Overlook Beacon.
Ride Marrowkeep’s elevator to the roof. Offer the flame at the golden lantern beside the fire to make @npc{Thestus} appear.
Ask Thestus on Marrowkeep’s roof to switch the world to day. Check Fainweald and Mammon again for the extra Beacons that only appear during the day, and claim their Ova.
Before choosing @mechanic{Send Ova} after the final boss, check for uncleansed Beacons and unclaimed rewards. If any are hard to locate, check an interactive map; plenty are available online.

achievements.description: Play all Lute Tracks in the Game
achievements.summary: Perform every available lute track.

steps.text: Take @item{Troubadour’s Lute} from the stage in @loc{One Legged Wolf Tavern}, southeast of One Legged Wolf Beacon.
Equip the lute, hold aim, and use the play input. On the default keyboard controls, press X and use the mouse wheel to change tracks. Play each available track.

achievements.description: Win the battle against Magdalena, the Lady of the Woods.
achievements.summary: Win the battle against Magdalena, the Lady of the Woods.

steps.text: At Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon, siphon seven Ova to unlock fast travel and the ability to clear corruption.
Cleanse @loc{Mushroom Village Gate Beacon}, then enter the nearby Corrupted Gate into @loc{Glutted Mire}. Win the battle against @enemy{Magdalena, the Lady of the Woods}.

achievements.displayName: Meat's Back on the Menu, Boys!
achievements.description: Win the battle against The Lost Child.
achievements.summary: Win the battle against The Lost Child.

steps.text: At Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon, siphon seven Ova to unlock fast travel and the ability to clear corruption.
Cleanse @loc{Stonebled Gate Beacon}, then enter the nearby Corrupted Gate into @loc{Sanguine Caverns}. Win the battle against @enemy{The Lost Child}.

achievements.description: Win the battle against The Nameless Captive.
achievements.summary: Win the battle against The Nameless Captive.

steps.text: At Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon, siphon seven Ova to unlock fast travel and the ability to clear corruption.
Earn @mechanic{Peter’s Perfect Parry} before killing this boss. If you still need the seven perfect guards, quit to the main menu before the fight ends and reload to retry from the Beacon.
Cleanse @loc{Nochtean Gate Beacon}, then enter the nearby Corrupted Gate into @loc{Prisoner’s Domain}. Win the battle against @enemy{The Nameless Captive}.

achievements.description: Win the battle against Sir Isaac, the Scholar-Prince.
achievements.summary: Win the battle against Sir Isaac, the Scholar-Prince.

steps.text: At Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon, siphon seven Ova to unlock fast travel and the ability to clear corruption.
Cleanse @loc{Gate of Infinity Beacon}, then enter the nearby Corrupted Gate into @loc{Faded Citadel}. Win the battle against @enemy{Sir Isaac, the Scholar-Prince}.

achievements.summary: Win the battle against Hexapod.

steps.text: At Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon, siphon seven Ova to unlock fast travel and the ability to clear corruption.
Cleanse @loc{Gate of Mammon Beacon}, then enter the nearby Corrupted Gate into @loc{Withered Shoals}. Win the battle against @enemy{Hexapod}.

achievements.summary: Defeat The Monolith.

steps.text: In @loc{The Unfound Path}, continue beyond @loc{Obsidian Vault} and defeat @enemy{The Monolith}.

achievements.description: Win the battle against Droeg, the Conquerer.
achievements.summary: Win the battle against Droeg, the Conquerer.

steps.text: At Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon, siphon seven Ova to unlock fast travel and the ability to clear corruption.
Cleanse @loc{Sester’s Gate Beacon}, then enter the nearby Corrupted Gate into @loc{Conquered Temple}. Win the battle against @enemy{Droeg, the Conquerer}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Malborn Offspring.

steps.text: In @loc{The Unfound Path}, pass @loc{Faithful’s Shelter Beacon} and defeat @enemy{Malborn Offspring}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Orrem, the Reclaimed.

steps.text: After defeating at least five Corrupted Gate bosses, take the stairs from Marrowkeep’s Ova room into @loc{The Unfound Path}. Defeat @enemy{Orrem, the Reclaimed} beyond @loc{Bridge of Procession Beacon}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Zmey, the Unbidden.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Orrem}, @enemy{The Monolith}, and @enemy{Malborn Offspring} in @loc{The Unfound Path}. Then fight @enemy{Zmey, the Unbidden} in the area’s center.

achievements.description: Gain Sester Genessa as a playable Shell.
achievements.summary: Gain Sester Genessa as a playable Shell.

steps.text: Use the southeast jump point from @loc{Outskirts of Mammon Beacon} to reach @loc{Revenant Graves}. In the northern part of the open area, touch the red glow that the Genessa illusions face.
Defeat @enemy{Sester Secundus} to receive @item{Sester’s Censer}. Give the censer to @npc{Sester Genessa} in Marrowkeep to unlock her Shell.

achievements.summary: Gain Tiel as a playable Shell.

steps.text: Southeast of @loc{Widow’s Overlook Beacon}, find the grave with a body outline in Tiel’s marked search area. Claim the Shell from the grave.

achievements.summary: Gain Lazlo as a playable Shell.

steps.text: West of @loc{High Lord’s Courtyard Beacon}, descend the large stairs into the underground area. Defeat @enemy{Vellen, High Lord of Mammon} at the end, then claim Lazlo’s body in the room behind him.

achievements.summary: Gain Eredrim as a playable Shell.

steps.text: At @loc{Citadel of Penance Beacon}, descend to the lowest level in the center. Step onto either elevator toward the upper middle platform to trigger @enemy{The Warden}.
Defeat The Warden, then claim Eredrim’s body in the arena.

achievements.summary: Gain Sariel as a playable Shell.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Sariel, the Endless} southeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}, then follow him through the southern wall into @loc{Chamber of Becoming}.
Pursue him to the final room. Break the four tombstones that revive him, defeat him, and claim his body.

achievements.summary: Gain Proxima as a playable Shell.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Shattered Beacon}, northeast of Blackridge Pass Beacon. Claim Proxima from the body at the back of the dungeon.

achievements.summary: Gain Smert as a playable Shell.

steps.text: Southwest of @loc{Outskirts of Nochte Beacon}, kill enemies on each of the three stone circles to make the blood offerings. Claim Smert’s body beside the statue at the back.

achievements.summary: Gain Gragu as a playable Shell.

steps.text: East of @loc{One Legged Wolf Beacon}, cross the Bone Gate to @loc{Temple of Vatra}. Open the offering chest for @item{Berserker’s Stone} before taking the Heart: light the statue’s two left candles and its right candle.
Climb the stairs to the rear statue and take @item{Heart of Vatra} from its hands.
Find @npc{Gragu} at the table left of the barkeep in @loc{One Legged Wolf Tavern}. Finish his dialogue, offer the heart, then inhabit his body after he dies.

achievements.description: Perfect-guard all seven hits of The Nameless Captive’s slower second-phase headspin combo with the Untarnished Seal.
achievements.summary: Perfect-guard all seven hits of The Nameless Captive’s slower second-phase headspin combo with the Untarnished Seal.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks as soon as the full combo is guarded; you can then finish the fight.

steps.text: At Marrowkeep’s Ova Siphon, siphon seven Ova to unlock fast travel and the ability to clear corruption.
Equip the @item{Untarnished Seal} before fighting @enemy{The Nameless Captive} in @loc{Prisoner’s Domain}, through the Corrupted Gate beside Nochtean Gate Beacon.
Lower the boss below half health. Wait past the fast spin attack that opens the second phase, then watch for the later, slower seven-hit headspin combo that turns the other way.
Perfect-guard all seven hits in that single combo. Watch for the pause before hit seven. Avoid killing or staggering the boss before the sequence finishes.
If the boss is nearly dead and the achievement has not unlocked, quit to the main menu and reload to retry from the Beacon. After killing the boss, the next opportunity is New Game+.

achievements.summary: Collect all Tarstones while holding one copy of every Fragile Tarstone in your inventory at the same time.

guide.context:
Gloombound Stone, Justiciar’s Stone, Egon’s Stone, and Glimpse Stone are Fragile stones that can wear out and break while equipped.

For The Collector’s night-only stock, first unlock @npc{Thestus}. Take @item{Gloombound Flame} from the stone pillar behind Great Arbiter of Flesh, south of Widow’s Overlook Beacon. Ride Marrowkeep’s elevator to the roof and offer the flame at the golden lantern beside the fire. After that, Thestus can change day and night whenever you ask.

For stones outside this checklist, check an interactive map; plenty are available online.

collectibles.name: Auspicious Stone
collectibles.location: Village southeast of Widow’s Overlook, west of Mushroom Village Beacon
collectibles.method: Light the three pillar candles to release the chest. Check the platform behind the chest, then climb the path on its right for another candle. For the last candle, take the left path and look behind the house near two enemies.

collectibles.name: Berserker’s Stone
collectibles.location: Temple of Vatra, east of One Legged Wolf Beacon through the Bone Gate
collectibles.method: Before taking the Heart of Vatra, light the statue’s two left candles and its right candle beside the stairs. Then open the offering chest and take the stone.
collectibles.note: Take this stone before collecting the Heart of Vatra.

collectibles.name: Marksman’s Stone
collectibles.location: Upper northeast path north of Mushroom Village Gate Beacon
collectibles.method: Open the chest among the three enemies.

collectibles.name: Bulwark Stone
collectibles.location: Southwest wall south of Citadel of Penance Beacon
collectibles.method: Pull the lever to open the wall gate. Pass the four enemies and open the chest at the broken bridge’s end.

collectibles.name: Retribution Stone
collectibles.location: North of Widow’s Overlook Beacon
collectibles.method: Start the Trial and win it to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Gloombound Stone
collectibles.location: Stones of Remembrance, northeast of Blackridge Pass Beacon
collectibles.method: Open the chest inside the ruined building at the graveyard’s center.
collectibles.note: Keep a spare copy while finishing the Tarstone collection.

collectibles.name: Justiciar’s Stone
collectibles.location: Swamp southeast of Feeding Grounds dungeon entrance
collectibles.method: Defeat the Broodshell Swarm, then collect the stone from the cave behind the fight.
collectibles.note: Keep a spare copy while finishing the Tarstone collection.

collectibles.name: Wounding Stone
collectibles.location: Tiel’s area southeast of Widow’s Overlook Beacon
collectibles.method: Go around the first house and open its chest.

collectibles.name: Grudge Stone
collectibles.location: Chest south of Citadel of Penance
collectibles.method: Collect the stone from the chest.

collectibles.name: Duality Stone
collectibles.location: Ravaged Tomb, below the southeast elevator from Nochtean Gate Beacon
collectibles.method: Descend the elevator and enter the dungeon at its foot. Open the chest under the large suspended body.

collectibles.name: Parasitic Stone
collectibles.location: Martyr’s Tomb, in the building southeast of Widow’s Overlook Beacon
collectibles.method: Enter the tomb and search the chest in its rear room.

collectibles.name: Shuddering Stone
collectibles.location: Illusionist’s Cache in Desolate Peak, southwest of Gloomshade Grove Beacon
collectibles.method: Follow the cliff to the Bone Gate and enter the dungeon through the building. Use arches to reveal paths and strike walls bearing white symbols. Move the block by striking it until it rests on the pressure plate. Open the chest beyond the wall that opens.

collectibles.name: Myriad Stone
collectibles.location: Feeding Grounds, at the northeastern edge of the Blackridge Pass graveyard
collectibles.method: Break the three glowing tombstones: one in the center, one left of the entrance stairs, and one on the upper path at the north edge. Enter the opened building and loot the main-floor chest. Crossing the middle floor drops you into an enemy fight.

collectibles.name: Volatile Fragment
collectibles.location: Inside Mushroom Village Gate Beacon
collectibles.method: Defeat Vrannic, the Grand Illusionist, to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Arbiter’s Prize
collectibles.location: Southeast of Widow’s Overlook Beacon
collectibles.method: Defeat Great Arbiter of Flesh to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Serpent Stone
collectibles.location: End of Stonebled Gate Beacon’s dungeon
collectibles.method: Defeat Lucian, the Thirsting Knight, to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Voltaic Crown
collectibles.location: End of Nochtean Gate Beacon’s dungeon
collectibles.method: Defeat Vrago, Solikar Champion, to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Inflamed Clawstone
collectibles.location: Holding Cells, above the jump pad north of Shrine of Trials
collectibles.method: Northwest of Mushroom Village Beacon, clear the jump pad’s corruption with Mether’s Breath. Use the well above to enter Holding Cells. On the far side of the lower floor, take the Feeding Room Key beside two bodies inside a building. Unlock the door halfway along the lower floor’s right side, then defeat the Rabid Grisha Pack.

collectibles.name: Hag Stone
collectibles.location: Inside Outskirts of Nochte Beacon
collectibles.method: Search the chest along the dungeon route.

collectibles.name: Emberseed Stone
collectibles.location: Inside Mushroom Village Beacon
collectibles.method: Search the chest along the dungeon route.

collectibles.name: Barrage Stone
collectibles.location: Southeast of Gloomshade Grove Beacon
collectibles.method: Start the Trial and win it to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Hand of Rock
collectibles.location: One Legged Wolf Tavern, southeast of One Legged Wolf Beacon
collectibles.method: Choose Order Drink when speaking to the Tavern Keeper. Buy the stone for 1,500 Coin.

collectibles.name: Headman’s Stone
collectibles.location: Ruins southeast of Outskirts of Mammon Beacon, near Grisha Hunters
collectibles.method: Round the northeastern corner of the ruins and open the chest beside the tree.

collectibles.name: Devout Stone
collectibles.location: Stairs north of Sester’s Gate Beacon
collectibles.method: Find the two ranged enemies and use the wall switch beside them. Open the chest behind the adjoining gate.

collectibles.name: Shattering Stone
collectibles.location: Collapsed Mine, west of the northern Obsidianite Mines elevator
collectibles.method: Ride that elevator up and take the west path into the mine. At the left/right fork, search the left dead end’s chest.

collectibles.name: Spite Stone
collectibles.location: Bellkeeper’s Corner, directly north of Abandoned Outpost Beacon
collectibles.method: Ring the bell to restore the bridge route to the dungeon. Inside, loot the chest on the small platform beside the bell.

collectibles.name: Unyielding Stone
collectibles.location: Stone circle north of Deserted Mine dungeon
collectibles.method: Start the Trial and win it to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Thief’s Stone
collectibles.location: Northeast of Gate of Infinity Beacon
collectibles.method: Find the circular platform opposite Ruk’s Map Fragment statue. Complete its Trial.

collectibles.name: Zealot’s Stone
collectibles.location: Besieged Ruins, east of High Lord’s Courtyard Beacon
collectibles.method: Drop two levels to the enemies and jump pad, then enter the nearby wall opening. At the dungeon’s rear, use the helmet with an arrow in it. Finish the knight flashback to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Clerik’s Stone
collectibles.location: Castle southwest of Disciple’s Stash dungeon
collectibles.method: Climb the path into the castle. Strike the false wall in its north corner and open the chest on the cliff beyond.

collectibles.name: Tyrant’s Stone
collectibles.location: Upper castle across the Bone Gate from Abbey Entrance Beacon
collectibles.method: Cross back into the castle and hit the wall on the right bearing a white mark. Open the chest behind it.

collectibles.name: Enfeebling Stone
collectibles.location: East of Outskirts of Mammon Beacon
collectibles.method: Start the Trial and win it to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Splitting Stone
collectibles.location: Balcony north of Sentry’s Grave entrance
collectibles.method: Circle the castle clockwise from the dungeon entrance and open the balcony chest.

collectibles.name: Unstable Stone
collectibles.location: Wooden platforms below and west of Castigator’s Keep Beacon
collectibles.method: Drop down and follow the stone pillars. On the second pillar’s north side, hit the false wall and open the concealed chest.

collectibles.name: Curseblood Stone
collectibles.location: Inside Gate of Infinity Beacon
collectibles.method: Take Grimorium Obscurum from the bookshelves and put it into the wall slot near the entrance. Follow the opened route and defeat Gloombound Wraith.

collectibles.name: Nightgrasp Stone
collectibles.location: Lower floor of the Map Fragment tower beyond Abbey Entrance Beacon
collectibles.method: Enter the castle and turn right toward the southwest tower. Light three candles: one beside the chest, one behind the Trial pillar, and one on the lower ledge to the left when facing the pillar from the tower. Open the chest.

collectibles.name: Wretchcaller’s Stone
collectibles.location: End of Gate of Mammon Beacon’s dungeon
collectibles.method: Defeat Infected Miner to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Viletongue Hedron
collectibles.location: Ova room inside Castigator’s Keep Beacon
collectibles.method: Use the object to the right of the Ova. With your movement controls reversed, defeat Viletongue Batushka.

collectibles.name: Voltaic Amber
collectibles.location: Vestige of Infinity, southwest of Castigator’s Keep Beacon
collectibles.method: Follow the southwest path and ride the elevator toward the south. Defeat Starved Harridan.

collectibles.name: Monarch’s Vestige
collectibles.location: Inside Abbey Entrance Beacon
collectibles.method: Follow the narrow path behind the houses and defeat the enemy emerging from a coffin. Take the Strange Village Key behind it, unlock the central door, and drop through the hole. Defeat Bor, the Deluded Monarch.

collectibles.name: Accursed Stone
collectibles.location: Inside Abandoned Outpost Beacon
collectibles.method: Drop to the lower floor and press the wall button to open the upper gate. Return upstairs and search the chest.

collectibles.name: Weeping Stone
collectibles.location: The Collector, south of Abandoned Outpost Beacon at night
collectibles.method: Ask Thestus to change the world to night. Buy this stone from The Collector for 1,500 Coin.

collectibles.name: Infused Stone
collectibles.location: The Collector, south of Abandoned Outpost Beacon at night
collectibles.method: Ask Thestus to change the world to night. Buy this stone from The Collector for 1,500 Coin.

collectibles.name: Colossus Stone
collectibles.location: Highest northeast platform beyond The Silent Steps Beacon
collectibles.method: Open the chest beside the Bone Gate that leads toward the eastern map area.

collectibles.name: Clockwork Shardstone
collectibles.location: Alchemist’s Workshop, below Castigator’s Keep
collectibles.method: South of Outskirts of Mammon Beacon, take the Makeshift Projectile from the glowing rock near the Grisha Hunters. Launch it with the catapult east of the Beacon’s Map Fragment statue. Descend from Castigator’s Keep, then head southwest along the wooden platforms to the opened workshop. Pass through the bookshelf and false wall, pull the side-room lever, and ride the elevator to the chest below.

collectibles.name: Fulminant Stone
collectibles.location: The Collector, south of Abandoned Outpost Beacon at night
collectibles.method: Ask Thestus to change the world to night. Buy this stone from The Collector for 1,500 Coin.

collectibles.name: Infested Stone
collectibles.location: The Collector, south of Abandoned Outpost Beacon at night
collectibles.method: Ask Thestus to change the world to night. Buy this stone from The Collector for 1,500 Coin.

collectibles.name: Siegebreaker’s Stone
collectibles.location: Offering chest in the first swamp
collectibles.method: Light the candle on the opposite house’s stair railing, the candle on the central stone pillar, and the candle in the cage behind the pillars. Open the chest.

collectibles.name: Corroded Stone
collectibles.location: Inside Sunken Village Beacon
collectibles.method: Climb the wooden platforms and follow the route down to the lower area. Open the chest just beyond the pair of enemies.

collectibles.name: Magdalena’s Memento
collectibles.location: Main boss arena
collectibles.method: Receive this stone after beating Magdalena, the Lady of the Woods.

collectibles.name: Shrike Stone
collectibles.location: Swamp beyond Seeping Mire Beacon
collectibles.method: Take the descending right path instead of the left route up to the bridge. Cross the long rope bridge and open the chest near the exploding enemies and two giant eels.

collectibles.name: Deadeye Stone
collectibles.location: First camp on the left after the area entrance
collectibles.method: Drop into the camp and search its chest.

collectibles.name: Blackblood Stone
collectibles.location: Upper floor inside Pulsing Caves Beacon
collectibles.method: Open the chest near the Stonecrab group.

collectibles.name: Lost Clotstone
collectibles.location: Main boss arena
collectibles.method: Defeat The Lost Child to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Tarred Fragment
collectibles.location: Beyond Sanguine Shoreline Beacon
collectibles.method: Defeat Tarblighted Stoner to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Ironpiercer’s Stone
collectibles.location: Upper platform inside Slumwater Drain Beacon
collectibles.method: Use the Bone Gate in the large room to reach the upper level. Search the chest on the arrival platform.

collectibles.name: Rupturing Stone
collectibles.location: Summon platform before the main boss
collectibles.method: Walk around to the platform’s far side and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Squall Stone
collectibles.location: Iron-maiden ghost room inside Executioner’s Pulpit Beacon
collectibles.method: Search the side room opposite the one with the button that opens the Ova route.

collectibles.name: Captive’s Scabstone
collectibles.location: Main boss arena
collectibles.method: Defeat The Nameless Captive to receive the stone. Earn Peter’s Perfect Parry before finishing the fight.

collectibles.name: Confessor’s Keepsake
collectibles.location: Beyond Slumwater Drain or Executioner’s Pulpit Beacon
collectibles.method: Defeat Tishina’s Confessor to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Pulse Stone
collectibles.location: Cave route beyond Winterglass Lake Beacon
collectibles.method: After the cave, find the Grisha Hunters and go left toward the stone hands. They reveal the chest containing the stone.

collectibles.name: Warden’s Stone
collectibles.location: Beyond Winterglass Lake Beacon
collectibles.method: Defeat Urrig, the Executioner, to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Frostshard Stone
collectibles.location: Further path inside Conqueror’s Hoard Beacon
collectibles.method: Take the path behind the Ova and cross the snowy areas. Open the chest before the large statue at the route’s end.

collectibles.name: Conqueror’s Reward
collectibles.location: Main boss arena
collectibles.method: Defeat Droeg, the Conquerer, to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Fusillade Stone
collectibles.location: End of Winterglass Lake Beacon’s dungeon
collectibles.method: Defeat Caged Grisha to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Stillblade’s Stone
collectibles.location: Citadel Annex Beacon’s dungeon, after the spider crossing
collectibles.method: Ride the spider across the gap. Defeat the enemy on the other side and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Scholar’s Wormstone
collectibles.location: Main boss arena
collectibles.method: Defeat Sir Isaac, the Scholar-Prince, to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Solnir Shard
collectibles.location: Beyond Citadel Annex Beacon
collectibles.method: Defeat Solnir, the Gloom Seeker, to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Summoning Stone
collectibles.location: Flame-lit tunnel beyond the second group with invulnerability fire
collectibles.method: Clear the second group of enemies and climb the tunnel stairs. Search the chest at the top.

collectibles.name: Charged Stone
collectibles.location: Inside Nameless Pass Beacon
collectibles.method: Take the right turn after the long tube and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Torpor Stone
collectibles.location: Behind Ossinite Falls Beacon
collectibles.method: Walk through the waterfall and open the concealed chest.

collectibles.name: Hexapod Core
collectibles.location: Main boss arena
collectibles.method: Defeat Hexapod to receive the stone.

collectibles.name: Strange Remnant
collectibles.location: Island reached from the right side of the area’s opening route
collectibles.method: Keep right until the Bone Gate to the island. Cross and defeat Strange Grisha.

collectibles.name: Acolyte’s Stone
collectibles.location: Merrick’s shop
collectibles.method: Buy the stone for 2,000 Coin.

collectibles.name: Unwieldly Stone
collectibles.location: Merrick’s shop
collectibles.method: Buy the stone for 2,000 Coin.

collectibles.name: Egon’s Stone
collectibles.location: Merrick’s expanded shop stock
collectibles.method: Check Merrick’s stock as you gather more Ova and buy one Egon’s Stone. Keep a copy in your inventory for the collection check.
collectibles.note: Keep a spare copy while finishing the Tarstone collection.

collectibles.name: Glimpse Stone
collectibles.location: Merrick’s shop, or Stonecrabs in The Unfound Path
collectibles.method: Gather more Ova until Merrick adds Glimpse Stones to his shop, then buy a copy for 2,500 Coin. For the farming route, collect 167 Ova to open The Unfound Path and kill the Stonecrabs around its central pillar. Keep a copy in your inventory for the collection check.
collectibles.note: Keep a spare copy while finishing the Tarstone collection.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum bonding tier for a Shell at the Shellkeeper
achievements.summary: Raise one Shell’s bond to Tier 4.

steps.text: At @npc{Zhirelle}’s bonding menu, spend @item{27 Glimpses} on one Shell to reach @mechanic{Tier 4}.

achievements.description: Max out a Weapon at the Tarforge
achievements.summary: Upgrade one weapon to +16 at the Tarforge.

steps.text: Upgrade a weapon at the @loc{Tarforge} until it reaches @mechanic{+16}. You will need 32 Ventrium, plus 31 Laterite and 31 Dorsalite. The total Coin cost is 57,000.

achievements.description: Give Egon enough Gloom to cause his death.
achievements.summary: Give Egon enough Gloom to cause his death.

steps.text: Southwest of @loc{Castigator’s Keep Beacon}, enter the castle and climb its central tower to @npc{Egon}. Give him the Gloom he requests until his death unlocks the achievement.

achievements.summary: Cleanse every Beacon that can be cleansed.

guide.context: The Beacons at Marrowkeep, Widow’s Overlook, and Outskirts of Mammon start in a cleansed state.

steps.text: Enter each uncleansed @mechanic{Beacon}, finish its dungeon, and claim the Ova at the end.
Include the Beacons in all six Corrupted Gate regions and @loc{The Unfound Path}. Check your fast-travel list for gaps before choosing Send Ova.
If you have not unlocked day/night switching, take @item{Gloombound Flame} from a stone pillar behind Great Arbiter of Flesh, south of Widow’s Overlook Beacon.
Ride Marrowkeep’s elevator to the roof. Offer the flame at the golden lantern beside the fire to make @npc{Thestus} appear.
Ask Thestus on Marrowkeep’s roof to switch the world to day. Check Fainweald and Mammon again for the extra Beacons that only appear during the day, and claim their Ova.
For missing Beacon locations, check an interactive map; plenty are available online.

achievements.description: Reduce the prologue Tar Golem’s health to zero.
achievements.summary: Reduce the prologue Tar Golem’s health to zero.

guide.context: The fight also ends if you take too long. For extra fire protection, defeat Tainted Vestige before Disciple’s Grotto and equip its Burnt Effigy.

steps.text: During the prologue, keep attacking @enemy{Tar Golem} until its health reaches zero. Parry its ordinary swings for ripostes and dodge its unblockable leaps.

If the attempt is going badly, pause and quit to the main menu while the fight is still active. Reload to restart before the Bone Gate. If the defeat scene finishes, start another save slot; New Game+ skips this fight.

achievements.summary: Collect all 11 Map Fragments.

steps.text: Visit each crow icon on the overworld map. Collect the fragment in front of @npc{Ruk}’s statue perch until you have all 11.
For any crow marker you cannot locate, check an interactive map; plenty are available online.

achievements.summary: Watch all 40 Shell Memories.

guide.context: You can farm enough Glimpses in one playthrough. Without refunds, all eight Tier 4 bonds cost 216 Glimpses in total.

steps.text: Unlock all eight Shells. At @npc{Zhirelle}, raise a Shell to @mechanic{Tier 4} with 27 Glimpses, then select and watch each of its five memories.

To reuse Glimpses, buy @item{Mether’s Severance} from @npc{Merrick} in Marrowkeep for 5,000 Coin. After watching all five memories, use the item at the Shellkeeper to refund that Shell’s Glimpses. Merrick sells three per playthrough.

For more Glimpses, buy @item{Glimpse Stones} from Merrick for 2,500 Coin each. Equip one and defeat 20 enemies to break it into three Glimpses. Farm more stones from the Stonecrabs around the central pillar in @loc{The Unfound Path}.
Track the Shells whose five memories you have watched and continue until all 40 count. A reset Shell’s memories can disappear from its menu when you switch back to that Shell.

achievements.summary: Obtain all eight playable Shells.

collectibles.name: Tiel
collectibles.location: Grave southeast of Widow’s Overlook Beacon
collectibles.method: Southeast of @loc{Widow’s Overlook Beacon}, find the grave with a body outline in Tiel’s marked search area. Claim the Shell from the grave.

collectibles.name: Proxima
collectibles.location: Shattered Beacon northeast of Blackridge Pass
collectibles.method: Enter @loc{Shattered Beacon}, northeast of Blackridge Pass Beacon. Claim Proxima from the body at the back of the dungeon.

collectibles.name: Eredrim
collectibles.location: The Warden’s arena below Citadel of Penance
collectibles.method: At @loc{Citadel of Penance Beacon}, descend to the lowest level in the center. Step onto either elevator toward the upper middle platform to trigger @enemy{The Warden}. Defeat The Warden, then claim Eredrim’s body in the arena.

collectibles.name: Smert
collectibles.location: Stone circles southwest of Outskirts of Nochte
collectibles.method: Southwest of @loc{Outskirts of Nochte Beacon}, kill enemies on each of the three stone circles to make the blood offerings. Claim Smert’s body beside the statue at the back.

collectibles.name: Gragu
collectibles.location: One Legged Wolf Tavern
collectibles.method: East of @loc{One Legged Wolf Beacon}, cross the Bone Gate to @loc{Temple of Vatra}. Open the offering chest for @item{Berserker’s Stone} before taking the Heart: light the statue’s two left candles and its right candle. Climb the stairs to the rear statue and take @item{Heart of Vatra} from its hands. Find @npc{Gragu} at the table left of the barkeep in @loc{One Legged Wolf Tavern}. Finish his dialogue, offer the heart, then inhabit his body after he dies.

collectibles.name: Sester Genessa
collectibles.location: Marrowkeep; quest starts at Revenant Graves
collectibles.method: Use the southeast jump point from @loc{Outskirts of Mammon Beacon} to reach @loc{Revenant Graves}. In the northern part of the open area, touch the red glow that the Genessa illusions face. Defeat @enemy{Sester Secundus} to receive @item{Sester’s Censer}. Give the censer to @npc{Sester Genessa} in Marrowkeep to unlock her Shell.

collectibles.name: Lazlo
collectibles.location: Underground rooms west of High Lord’s Courtyard
collectibles.method: West of @loc{High Lord’s Courtyard Beacon}, descend the large stairs into the underground area. Defeat @enemy{Vellen, High Lord of Mammon} at the end, then claim Lazlo’s body in the room behind him.

collectibles.name: Sariel
collectibles.location: Chamber of Becoming, southeast of The Silent Steps
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Sariel, the Endless} southeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}, then follow him through the southern wall into @loc{Chamber of Becoming}. Pursue him to the final room. Break the four tombstones that revive him, defeat him, and claim his body.

achievements.summary: Obtain all eight sidearms.

collectibles.name: Nayleshotte
collectibles.location: Prologue
collectibles.method: Receive this weapon during the opening equipment tutorial.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Crossbow
collectibles.location: Flooded Village, northwest of Blackridge Pass
collectibles.method: Find the building northwest of @loc{Blackridge Pass Beacon}. Use its arch to reveal the doorway into @loc{Flooded Village}. Descend past the second elevator to the underground village. Take the @item{Damp Key} from the box beside the house at the back left. Unlock the central building and take the crossbow from its table.

collectibles.name: Salvaged Trebuchaxe
collectibles.location: Ravaged Hideout, south of Gloomshade Grove
collectibles.method: South of @loc{Gloomshade Grove Beacon}, defeat @enemy{Bloodcursed Lithopod} to open the route into @loc{Ravaged Hideout}. Take the Trebuchaxe from the body in the final room.

collectibles.name: Troubadour’s Lute
collectibles.location: One Legged Wolf Tavern stage
collectibles.method: Take the lute from the tavern stage southeast of One Legged Wolf Beacon.

collectibles.name: Triarch Repeater
collectibles.location: Blackwell Cavern, below Castigator’s Keep
collectibles.method: Descend behind @loc{Castigator’s Keep Beacon} and take the lower path north. Enter @loc{Blackwell Cavern} by the cliff, then collect the repeater from the ground in the first lit area.

collectibles.name: Ballistazooka
collectibles.location: Sentry’s Grave, northwest of Gate of Mammon
collectibles.method: Climb the northwest stairs from @loc{Gate of Mammon Beacon}. Follow the building clockwise to the indoor stairs into @loc{Sentry’s Grave}. Defeat @enemy{Subjugated Guardian} at the dungeon’s end to receive the Ballistazooka.

collectibles.name: Cursed Child
collectibles.location: Revered Beacon, reached from Sester’s Gate
collectibles.method: From @loc{Sester’s Gate Beacon}, climb the northwest stairs past the rolling enemy. Drop from the western platform to the Bone Gate ledge, then follow the path north past the hammer enemy to @loc{Revered Beacon}. Inside, move counterclockwise toward the tower on the hill. Use walls for cover from the golden light, which damages you while it can see you. Strike the tower’s central pillar to stop the light, then pick up the @item{Cursed Child}.

collectibles.name: Caged Hystrix
collectibles.location: Chamber of Becoming, southeast of The Silent Steps
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Sariel, the Endless} southeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}. Follow him through the opened southern wall into @loc{Chamber of Becoming}. In the final fight, break the four tombstones that revive Sariel and defeat him. Climb the stairs at the back and take the @item{Caged Hystrix} near the exit.

achievements.summary: Obtain all eight melee weapons.

collectibles.name: The Iconoclast
collectibles.location: Prologue
collectibles.method: Receive this weapon during the opening equipment tutorial.

collectibles.name: Axe and Dagger
collectibles.location: Shrine of Trials, northwest of Mushroom Village
collectibles.method: South of @loc{Mushroom Village Beacon}, find the large pyre. Walk through the arch on the platform’s north edge while facing the fire. Take the @item{Chapel Key} from the rope on the revealed statue. Use the key at @loc{Shrine of Trials}, northwest of Mushroom Village Beacon. In the first room, face the statue and walk backward through the wall. Strike the puzzle blocks onto the floor switches in the remaining rooms. Take the @item{Axe and Dagger} at the end.

collectibles.name: Veteran’s Battle Axe
collectibles.location: The King’s Crypt, northwest of Shattered Beacon
collectibles.method: Enter @loc{The King’s Crypt} through the cave northwest of Shattered Beacon. Follow the main route down the long drop, then take the axe from the body beside the enemy.

collectibles.name: Great Martyr’s Blade
collectibles.location: Martyr’s Prison, northwest of Gloomshade Grove
collectibles.method: Find the castle northwest of @loc{Gloomshade Grove Beacon}. At its outer northeast corner, enter @loc{Martyr’s Prison} through the hole in the wall. Use the bag on the stone counter. In the next area, defeat the four enemies in the locked room and take the blade from the room they guard.

collectibles.name: Obsidian Hammer
collectibles.location: Obsidianite Mines, below Deserted Slums
collectibles.method: From @loc{Outskirts of Mammon Beacon}, take the southwest paths and wooden bridges to @loc{Deserted Slums}. Drop into the central mining pit and enter @loc{Obsidianite Mines} on its southwest side. Reach the dungeon’s end and defeat @enemy{Prophet of Profane Infinities} to receive the hammer.

collectibles.name: Black Needle
collectibles.location: Inside Sester’s Gate Beacon
collectibles.method: Enter @loc{Sester’s Gate Beacon} and defeat the @enemy{Twin Sesters and Stray Sesters} at the end to receive the Black Needle.

collectibles.name: Axatana
collectibles.location: Tower northeast of The Silent Steps
collectibles.method: Northeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}, climb to the highest northeastern platform. Cross its Bone Gate to the tower near the eastern Corrupted Gate. Press the button behind the tower to open the gate. Defeat the enemy inside and take the @item{Axatana}.

collectibles.name: Clockwork Scythe
collectibles.location: Chamber of Becoming, southeast of The Silent Steps
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Sariel, the Endless} on the stone platform southeast of @loc{The Silent Steps Beacon}. Follow him through the wall he opens to the south into @loc{Chamber of Becoming}. Pursue Sariel through the dungeon. In the last fight, destroy the four tombstones that let him revive, then finish the fight to receive the scythe.

achievements.description: Obtain a Mango from the giant Mango in Mango Sanctuary.
achievements.summary: Obtain a Mango from the giant Mango in Mango Sanctuary.

steps.text: In @loc{Sanguine Caverns}, descend the hole after @loc{Pulsing Caves Beacon}. At the bottom, turn back before leaving the cave and pass the exploding bodies. Take @item{Mether’s Flesh} from the pillar to the right of the chest.
Go to the river cave by @loc{Outskirts of Nochte Beacon}. Use the cup in front of the large fish and offer Mether’s Flesh to enter @loc{Mango Sanctuary}.
Use the giant Mango to collect a @item{Mango} and unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Trigger the ending by sending Ova after defeating Zmey.

steps.text: After defeating @enemy{Zmey}, finish the collections and memories you want to complete in this playthrough.
Return to the @loc{Ova Siphon} in Marrowkeep and choose @mechanic{Send Ova} to trigger the ending and enter New Game+.

achievements.description: Unlock All Achievements for Mortal Shell II
achievements.summary: Earn every other Mortal Shell II achievement.

steps.text: Complete the other 52 achievements.

achievements.summary: Trigger Baghead’s secret ending.

guide.context: Giving Baghead an item closes this route for the playthrough; the next opportunity is New Game+. The secret ending itself lets you reload and keep playing.

steps.text: Southwest of @loc{Gloomshade Grove Beacon}, take the Bone Gates to @loc{Desolate Peak}. Speak to @npc{Baghead} until he invites you to sit with his followers, then sit down.
Talk to Baghead again and answer @mechanic{Yes} until he asks you to bring something. @warn{Do not give him any of the nearby items}. Sit with the followers a second time.
Speak to Baghead again and keep answering @mechanic{Yes} to trigger the secret ending. After the credits, reload your save to resume at the nearby Beacon.
